verdict.rationale: Internal comment threads and @mentions beside a message are a fair capability to expect from an email service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents filters, templates, snooze, scheduled send, aliases, Masked Email and the JMAP API, but nothing about internal comments, @mentions or shared discussion on a message.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
